demo_story: Nimbus qualifies on the original RFP (bid with conditions). The corrigendum extends the deadline past the ISO/IEC 27001 expiry, so the same bid becomes a no-bid on a hard gate even though the weighted score improves.
three_minute_demo_moments: Upload tender -> requirements with pages; live mandatory recall on the gold set
Complex OR clause (PQ-05) and MSE relaxation (PQ-02) computed in code with a readable trace
Load corrigendum -> deadline moves, ISO 27001 flips to gap, only affected checks re-run
Injection annex quarantined; verifier strikes 'CMMI Level 5'
replay_policy: Cache validated outputs per case; label any replay as replay on screen.

cases.name: Normal qualifying tender (bid path, one cited section)

expected.reason: All hard gates met or closable by actions; conditions: REQ-LEG-001 unlimited_liability -> MD & CEO; REQ-ELG-015: Request bid-specific MAF from OpsCentral (owner: Head - Bids)
key_points: PQ-02 turnover meets only via MSE relaxation (52.00 vs 45; general 55 fails)
PQ-05 meets via branch (b): PRJ-001 + PRJ-002
PQ-06 meets with a 4-day margin on ISO/IEC 27001 (warning)
Security Lead: substitute NDS-E110 for NDS-E105
Unlimited liability carve-outs need CEO approval (deal-breaker policy)
Actions: bid-specific MAF, PQ-9 undertaking, PQ-6 declaration
expected.draft_target: Format T-1 sections 2 and 4 (O&M approach and security operations), 400-700 words, every claim cited

cases.name: Expired ISO/IEC 27001 at the effective deadline (no-bid)

expected.reason: Hard gate failure: REQ-ELG-009. The weighted score (78.8) cannot override a hard gate.
key_points: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 valid to 2026-11-10 < effective deadline 2026-11-20T15:00 => PQ-06 gap (hard gate)
Weighted score rises (better PBG, payment, penalty cap) but cannot override the hard gate
Mitigation: recertification audit 16-18 Nov; renewed certificate typically 2-4 weeks later; pre-bid response 9 rejects audit letters => needs human confirmation
Never state the certificate is valid at the deadline
expected.gate1: Human sees NO_BID with mitigation option; drafting stops unless overridden with evidence
